core_struggle: Has chosen to act and now wants to steady their mind through the result, without being carried away by either win or loss.
mirror: You are ready to act, and the question is what to hold when the result comes.

queries.hook: The resolve to act, and the steadiness to hold when the result arrives, whether it is the one you hoped for or not.
queries.diagnose: Resolve fades when the mind runs ahead to the prize or looks sideways at others; it holds when the work itself is the reward.
queries.steady: No honest effort on the right path is ever wasted; even a little of it protects you and carries you forward.
queries.act: Rise and act; do your work fully and well, let the result go, and keep at it whether the world cheers or falls silent.
queries.story: A warrior who set out to act, faced the result, and kept their resolve steady through it.

bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call starting what is yours to build, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: The steadiness you want is not in the result but in the work itself. Seven days from resolve to the practice that holds you through it.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the resolve and the steadiness you want, named without weight.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the mind swings when it holds on to the prize.
week_beats.story: A warrior who set out to act shows you how resolve survives the result.

insight: You have chosen to act, and the steadiness you want is not in the result but in the work itself. The mind swings only when it holds on to the prize.
life_context: A person who has chosen to act and now wants to steady their mind through the result, without being carried away by either win or loss.
details: wants to stay balanced whether they win or lose
does not want to get carried away by either outcome
